motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code, Chapters 10.10 Parking. Grants Coordinator/Management Analyst Natalie Winterton reviewed the changes requested by the City Council during the work session that differ from the proposed amendment in the packet materials: 1. 10.10.30 – It is unlawful to leave any vehicle parked continuously on a public street for longer than 72 hours without being moved having been driven a distance of at least 400 feet before returning to the same location; 2. 10.10.090(B) – “Commercial vehicle” means a tractor or motor vehicle at or exceeding a rated capacity of 2.5 tons, trailer, or semi-trailer used or maintained for the transportation of persons or property that operates: 1. As a carrier for hire, compensation, or profit; 2. As a carrier to transport the vehicle owner’s goods or property in furtherance of the owner’s commercial enterprise; or 3. As a food cart or food truck; 3. 10.10.090(F)(5) – remove completely and adjust the numbering accordingly rather than removing van and adding boat as presented in the packet materials; and 4. 10.10.100(A)(2) – Agricultural vehicle, recreational vehicle, or occupied or empty trailer, within the front yard area (excluding a paved or gravel driveway) of any residential zone of the city. Ms. Winterton clarified that she had discussed the definitions of commercial vehicles with the Planning Commission in regard to a different amendment. Changes to this chapter do not require Planning Commission review. Councilmember Gray suggested allowing commercial vehicles up to 2.5 tons and amending the prohibition to state vehicles over 2.5 tons. The Council supported amending EMMC 10.10.090(B) to a “vehicle exceeding a rated capacity of 2.5 tons.” Councilmember Wright confirmed with Mayor Westmoreland that he is comfortable with the enforcement of the proposed changes. Eagle Mountain City Council Meeting – March 7, 2023 Page 9 of 12
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to approve an ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code, Chapters 10.10 Parking as presented with the corrective changes. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
